headline: Pakistan Freelancer Export Earnings Hit Record $210 Million in October
summary: Pakistan's monthly freelancer export earnings surged 53% year-on-year to an all-time high of $210 million in October 2026, bringing the four-month total to $760 million.
why: Export earnings from digital services contribute significantly to foreign exchange reserves and current account stability in developing economies.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Record digital export revenues strengthen the country's foreign exchange earnings.
